Our Business Model

Direct Shipping Ore

Our Direct Shipping Ore (DSO) approach provides immediate cash flow by selling high-grade, surface-level copper-cobalt oxide material to local warehouses and Gécamines-approved facilities. This strategy funds ongoing exploration without equity dilution — creating a self-sustaining operational model that accelerates discovery while demonstrating early economic viability.

Operational Strategy We operate DSO for copper cuttings, processing at top facilities in DRC or Zambia. Final product ships to the client’s chosen destination. Whether FOB or CIF, we tailor terms to client needs — ensuring flexibility and reliability across all commodity grades.

Methodology

Geo-botanical
Prospecting

Our proprietary non-invasive technique uses native hyperaccumulator flora as bio-indicators of subsurface mineralisation — validated since 2018.

01
Hyperaccumulator Mapping

Field teams identify native hyperaccumulator plants that concentrate specific metals from soil. Their distribution directly indicates subsurface mineralisation, reducing drill costs and environmental impact.

02
Topsoil & Surface Sampling

Systematic topsoil sampling and field rock identification at H-Robertii. Sample finds GPS-tagged and logged. Scheelite-bearing skarn exposed at surface across multiple outcrops.

03
Drill Core UV Testing

Scan drill cores with UV light for blue fluorescence — the diagnostic signature of scheelite (CaWO₄). Assay tungsten values to determine ore grade and economic viability.

04
Satellite Verification

Satellite imagery validation of all target zones (WGS84). H-Robertii confirmed at -10.58772, 25.23768 — 4,249 ft. Aerial mapping confirms structural geology consistent with skarn mineralisation.
